mapper.insert: INSERT INTO note_image (note_id, original_name, storage_key, mime_type, size_bytes, sort_order, create_time) VALUES (#{noteId}, #{originalName}, #{storageKey}, #{mimeType}, #{sizeBytes}, #{sortOrder}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, note_id, original_name, storage_key, mime_type, size_bytes, sort_order, create_time FROM note_image WHERE note_id = #{noteId} ORDER BY sort_order, id

SELECT i.id, i.note_id, i.original_name, i.storage_key, i.mime_type, i.size_bytes, i.sort_order, i.create_time FROM note_image i JOIN note n ON n.id = i.note_id WHERE i.note_id = #{noteId} AND i.original_name = #{name} AND n.delete_time IS NULL
